senses.gloss: to relieve an animal broken down under its load (v. פָּרַק), help to unload. Mekh. Mishp. s. 20 (ref. to Ex. XXIII, 5) פעמים שאתה חדל ופעמים שאתה עוֹזֵב at times you may abstain, at times you must help.
units: <cite ref="Exodus 23:5">Ib.</cite> <he>פריקה מנין ת״ל עָזוֹב וכ׳</he> whence do we derive the duty of unloading? It says (Ex. l. c.), thou must release with him; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 32a:17">B. Mets. 32ᵃ</cite>. Tanḥ.
<cite ref="Exodus 1">Mishp. 1</cite> <he>עֲזוֹב קימעה מכאן וכ׳</he> loosen (the load) here a little, raise there &c.

<cite ref="Sotah 12a:2">Sot. 12ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 1">Ex. R. s. 1</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="P00400"><he>עזובה</he></cite>, <cite ref="I Chronicles 2:18">I Chr. II, 18</cite>) <he>עזובה … שהכל עֲזָבוּהָ</he> Azubah is Miriam … for all (young men) left her alone (ignored her on account of her sickliness).
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 10:7">Midr. Till. to Ps. X</cite> <he>וציון אמרה עֶזָבַנִי וכ׳</he> and Zion said, he has forsaken and forgotten me.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 92:5">Midr. Till. to Ps. XCII</cite> <he>מי שמורה … ועוֹזֵב וכ׳</he> he who confesses his sins and forsakes (them, <cite ref="Proverbs 28:13">Prov. XXVIII, 13</cite>); a. fr.

senses.gloss: to untie, release; to effect a divorce.
units: <cite ref="Gittin 32b:4">Gitt. 32ᵇ</cite> <he>גט זה … לא יַעֲזִיב</he> this letter shall have no effect, shall not untie, shall not release, contrad. to <he>אינו מַעֲזִיב</he> does not release, v. <cite ref="J00485"><he>יָעַל</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 527:1">Yalk. Hos. 527</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 1:4">Is. I, 4</cite>) <he>אל תיקרי עזבו אלא עִיזְּבוּ</he> read not, ‘they have forsaken’, but, ‘they have made (me) worth abandoning (caused me to be cruel); Tanḥ. B’huck. 2 <he>עוזבו אתי</he> (read <he>עיזבו אותי</he>).
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 31:1">Pesik. R. s. 31</cite> (ref. to <he>עזבני</he>, <cite ref="Isaiah 49:14">Is. XLIX, 14</cite>) <he>עִיזְּבַנִי</he> he has made me contemptible.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 35">Lev. R. s. 35</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 37:25">Ps. XXXVII, 25</cite>) <he>נ׳ מיראתו וכ׳</he> forsaken of his fear of the Lord.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 45:4">Gen. R. s. 45</cite> <he>ומִתְעַזֶּבֶת</he>, v. <cite ref="K00974"><he>כָּעַר</he></cite>; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:14:8">Cant. R. to II, 14</cite> <he>ומתעבת</he>, ed. Wil. <he>מתעובת</he> (corr. acc., or read: <he>מְתוֹעֶבֶת</he>, v. <cite ref="V00773"><he>תָּעַב</he></cite>). Pesik. R. l. c. <he>והיו … ומִתְעַזְּבוֹת בפניהם</he> and they became abominable and hateful in their sight.
